items.heading: Machboos
details: Key ingredients: rice, chicken or lamb, dried lime, baharat spice
Brown chicken or lamb with onions and baharat spice blend.
Add dried lime and tomato, then simmer until the meat is tender.
Cook rice in the meat's spiced broth until fully absorbed.
Serve the spiced rice topped with the meat and fried onions.

items.heading: Muhammar
details: Key ingredients: rice, dates, sugar, cardamom, rosewater
Cook rice until nearly tender.
Simmer chopped dates with sugar and cardamom into a thick syrup.
Fold the sweet date syrup through the cooked rice.
Steam briefly to finish and serve as a sweet side dish.
